newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Fuel prices will not rise in March because the dollar-leu rate dropped lately, said Ionita Vifor, head of the Romanian Oil Company (CRP). Vifor said fuel prices might go down if the leu strengthens further.
* Upper Senate's legal commission has heard Senator Corneliu Vadim Tudor over slander accusations following stories published by his weekly "Romania Mare".
The Senate started procedures to strip Tudor of his parliamentary immunity, at the request of the justice minister.
* Senate chairman Petre Roman held a news conference on his recent visit to Spain where he met Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar and King Juan Carlos I.

* NATO's expansion without Romania and Poland would be non-sensical, Jonathan Eyal, head of the British Centre for Strategic Studies, told a news conference called by exiled King Michael's spokesman. Eyal said Michael will greatly help to promote Romania's interests in the Nordic countries.
* Romania's and Hungary's ambassadors to the United Nations have submitted the text of their bilateral treaty to the UN secretary general.
